slides.text: DevOps is an idea; SRE is a practice. ● A cohort of of Site Reliability Engineers, organised and managed as a group, form an SRE team. ● SRE teams are versatile! ○ Code reviews, incident response, facilitate post-mortems ○ Supports a dedicated portfolio or a product team ○ Individual SREs may rotate in and out of products, sprints (though some might not)
